title: Products over coherent rings are flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative coherent ring, meaning that every finitely generated ideal of $R$ is finitely presented as an $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. For any set $A$ and family $(Q_a)_{a\in A}$ of flat $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], the product $\prod_{a\in A}Q_a$, consisting of all families with componentwise module operations, is flat over $R$.

proof.text: To prove flatness, apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-fg-ideal-criterion]: it suffices to check, for an arbitrary finitely generated ideal $I\subset R$, that the multiplication map $\mu:I\otimes_R\prod_{a\in A}Q_a\to\prod_{a\in A}Q_a$ is injective. The coherence hypothesis in the statement says exactly that this $I$ is finitely presented as an $R$-module.

source.place: Tag 05CZ, proposition-characterize-coherent, proof of (1) implies (2), first paragraph; flatness criterion Tag 00HD

proof.text: By [lem-trf-finite-presentation-tensor-products], the canonical map $\theta:I\otimes_R\prod_{a\in A}Q_a\to\prod_{a\in A}(I\otimes_RQ_a)$, sending $i\otimes(q_a)_a$ to $(i\otimes q_a)_a$, is bijective because $I$ is finitely presented. For each $a$, flatness of $Q_a$ and [lem-weil-pbc-flat-fg-ideal-criterion] make the multiplication map $\mu_a:I\otimes_RQ_a\to Q_a$ injective.

source.place: Tag 05CZ, proposition-characterize-coherent, proof of (1) implies (2), second and third sentences

proof.text: Under $\theta$, the map $\mu$ is the product of the maps $\mu_a$: on a pure tensor $i\otimes(q_a)_a$ both send it to $(iq_a)_a$, and pure tensors generate the tensor product. The product map $\prod_a\mu_a$ is injective componentwise: if two families have equal images, their $a$-components are equal for every $a$ because each $\mu_a$ is injective. Therefore $\mu$ is injective. Since $I$ was arbitrary, [lem-weil-pbc-flat-fg-ideal-criterion] proves that $\prod_{a\in A}Q_a$ is flat. The argument also covers $A=\varnothing$, where the product is the zero module and the product map has empty coordinate condition.

source.place: Tag 05CZ, proof of (1) implies (2), final injectivity argument
